summary: Wave 2 Phase 3 is accepted after one small acceptance fix. The required Phase 3 guard chain exits 0: passWithNoTests count 0, live-default prod-smoke count 0, marketing truthfulness counters 0, and @reading-advantage/types remains 5 files / 90 tests. Live smoke behavior is genuine: with RUN_LIVE_SMOKE unset, phase-1 prod-smoke skips network probes rather than passing them; with RUN_LIVE_SMOKE=true and no PHASE1_PROD_URL, the suite exits 1. Real suites still run after passWithNoTests removal: sales 24/24 and marketing 158/158 pass. Root CI remains intentionally narrow and honestly scoped to 4 CodeCamp cold-start/local-image files / 27 tests, not a monorepo aggregate. Acceptance fixed an A7 live-smoke guard weakness where the good fixture still modeled a production URL fallback and the guard treated RUN_LIVE_SMOKE token presence as sufficient; the strengthened guard now rejects production URL defaults even when RUN_LIVE_SMOKE appears. Plan markers and claims are truthful, A1/A3/A4/A5/A6/A7 checks pass, and known out-of-scope failures remain pre-existing and owner-labeled.
nonblocking_findings: Acceptance found and fixed an in-scope A7 guard weakness: apps/codecamp-advantage/lib/__tests__/prod-smoke/wave2-fixtures/opt-in-gated.fixture.ts used `process.env.PHASEX_PROD_URL ?? "https://codecamp.reading-advantage.com"`, and wave2-live-smoke-opt-in.test.ts previously allowed any file containing RUN_LIVE_SMOKE. Commit 251fec66 strengthens detection to reject production URL defaults even when RUN_LIVE_SMOKE is present and updates the good fixture to require an env URL with no fallback.
